T1.name: Testing & Commissioning
T1.inven: US private companies whose primary business is FIELD SERVICE: electrical acceptance and maintenance testing, power system commissioning, protective relay testing and calibration, arc flash studies, infrared thermography of electrical systems - NETA-type independent testing firms serving commercial, industrial and utility power systems. STRICTLY EXCLUDE test-equipment manufacturers, instrument makers, equipment distributors, calibration labs for instruments, and engineering-design-only firms - we want companies that send technicians to customer sites. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential electrical, solar installation, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

T2.name: Apparatus Service
T2.inven: US private companies providing shop and field repair, reconditioning, rebuild and life-extension services for electrical apparatus: circuit breakers, switchgear, transformers, load tap changers, protective relays. EASA/PEARL-type apparatus service shops. STRICTLY EXCLUDE OEM manufacturers, remanufacturers who primarily sell equipment, parts distributors and resellers - we want service businesses. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

T3.name: Utility Line & Substation
T3.inven: US private utility line contractors: overhead and underground electric distribution and transmission line construction and maintenance, substation construction and maintenance, storm restoration, live-line work for electric utilities, cooperatives and municipals. STRICTLY EXCLUDE heavy-civil general contractors, telecom-only contractors, and equipment manufacturers. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

T4.name: Industrial Plant Electrical
T4.inven: US private industrial electrical service companies serving manufacturing plants and process facilities: plant electrical maintenance, medium-voltage work inside plants, motor control centers, VFDs, industrial controls and automation service, shutdown/turnaround electrical work. STRICTLY EXCLUDE panel-shop-only manufacturers, product OEMs and distributors - we want service providers with field crews. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

T5.name: Commercial & Institutional
T5.inven: US private commercial electrical contractors whose revenue is led by RECURRING SERVICE AND MAINTENANCE - service departments, preventive maintenance programs, 24/7 emergency electrical response for commercial, institutional and light-industrial facilities. STRICTLY EXCLUDE pure design-build or new-construction-led contractors and tenant-fit-out specialists - the recurring service line is the thesis. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

T6.name: Critical Power & Data Ctr
T6.inven: US private critical-power service companies: UPS maintenance and repair, battery system service and replacement, standby generator maintenance, data center electrical services, emergency power system testing for mission-critical facilities. STRICTLY EXCLUDE UPS/generator manufacturers and pure equipment distributors or rental houses - we want the service organizations. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

S7.name: Motor & Generator
S7.inven: US private electric motor and generator repair shops: motor rewinding, rebuild, dynamic balancing, vibration analysis, field service for rotating electrical equipment - EASA-type shops serving industrial customers. STRICTLY EXCLUDE motor manufacturers and pure motor/parts distributors - repair and field service must lead. Revenue $2M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

S8.name: Traffic Signals & Lighting
S8.inven: US private contractors specializing in traffic signal construction and maintenance, street and roadway lighting maintenance, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) installation, airport lighting - serving DOTs, municipalities and public agencies. STRICTLY EXCLUDE fixture/pole manufacturers and sign-only companies. Revenue $5M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

S9.name: EV Charging
S9.inven: US private companies providing EV charging infrastructure SERVICES for commercial and fleet customers: EVSE installation, ongoing operations and maintenance of DC fast chargers and Level 2 networks, charger repair and uptime contracts. STRICTLY EXCLUDE charger manufacturers, charging network owners/operators funded by VC to own assets, car dealerships, and LED-retrofit firms that merely mention EV. Revenue $2M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential, solar-only, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.

S10.name: Lightning Protection
S10.inven: US private installers of lightning protection systems, grounding and bonding systems, and surge protection for commercial, industrial and institutional structures - UL-listed / LPI-certified system installers. STRICTLY EXCLUDE component manufacturers and pure surge-device distributors. Revenue $2M-$50M (include unknown-revenue companies when employee count is 10-250), employees 10-250. Ownership: any private company that is not PE-backed and not a subsidiary; exclude PE-backed, public, and subsidiaries. Exclude residential-only, solar, fire alarm, structured cabling, security systems, home services.
